description: List native object identities with reviewed mappings. A listed topic does not guarantee a current answer; use answer_lookup for current availability.

type.description: Filter by object type, e.g. state, program, regime, bank, legal_form.

name: answer_objects

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

title: List reviewed native topics
